en.title: Epic Seven Steam-specific notes
en.meta: STOVE link, anti-cheat, languages, system requirements, cross-play. Independent guide.
en.lead: Practical differences on the Steam build vs mobile / STOVE PC. Drawn from public Steam store + STOVE FAQ.
acct: Steam requires a third-party STOVE account (supports linking to Steam).
Convert existing email/SNS → Steam login to keep progress (guide).
Cross-play across Steam, STOVE PC, and mobile (per FAQ).
Steam can play new and existing worlds; Foundry has separate matchmaking for listed PvP modes.
sec: Steam store lists kernel-level anti-cheat UNCHEATER. Expect elevated prompts; locked-down PCs may block launch.
Free-to-play with in-app purchases; Family Sharing flagged on store.
en.lang: Interface includes EN/KR/JP/ZH(trad/simp)/DE/FR/ES/PT/TH (per launch notice). Voice at launch: Korean / English; Japanese VO delayed with later resume planned.
